name: Inkling
blurb: A calmer place to think. Talk to it and it writes down what you said, without sending a word anywhere.

name: Nightfall
blurb: A narrator and moderator for Werewolf, so nobody has to sit out to run the game.

name: Greenroom
blurb: A quieter place to talk about film. Connection over collection.

name: VibeDeck
blurb: Everyone at the party gets a say in what plays next. The host runs Apple Music, the room votes, the queue moves live.
